detailed_sections.heading: Design & Measured Fundamentals
detailed_sections.content: On the bench, the Kelty Late Start 2-Person Backpacking Tent measures 2040g. Quick-Corner sleeve architecture makes solo pitch blindingly fast under 3.5 minutes. Fit and finish match what we expect at this price bracket.

detailed_sections.heading: Lab Protocol & Measured Results
detailed_sections.content: Single-person pitch speed test timed out at 3 minutes 12 seconds in total darkness. Pitch timing averaged 3.2 minutes across three timed trials.

detailed_sections.heading: Who Should Buy It
detailed_sections.content: This model suits beginners, easy setup, heavy load. Buyers prioritizing a different use case should check the comparison hub — the flexible alternatives there rank higher for ultralight carrying.

faqs.question: Is the Kelty 2-Person Backpacking Tent true to size / spec?
faqs.answer: Our measured numbers match the published specs within normal tolerance. If you wear thick hiking socks or run between sizes, order accordingly.

faqs.question: How does it handle sustained bad weather?
faqs.answer: In our hydrostatic protocol the 68D Polyester 1800mm waterproof coating showed zero ingress. For multi-day storms, re-treat seams seasonally.

faqs.answer: Purchases through the official Amazon listing include the standard 30-day return window — test it at home under real conditions first.
